item.description: Fancy a chauffeur? Uber is courting the well-heeled with a new ride option that will see it extend its reach from a taxi alternative to a more exclusive limousine-style service. item.title: Women are less likely to apply for jobs with a huge pay range. Here’s what companies can do about it
item.description: Pay transparency laws were supposed to address the pay disparities that tend to impact women and people of color in the workplace. item.title: Why the U.S. is now more resilient to oil price shocks
